notes: Token usage and API cost are not accessible to the agent; omitted.

import.meta.glob auto-discovery was initially implemented but proved unreliable under vitest's vite-node for relative patterns; replaced with a build-time registry generator (scripts/generate-registry.mjs), which is one of the approaches sanctioned by the spec section 9.
Generated registry file is gitignored and regenerated by predev/prebuild/pretest/pretypecheck, eliminating shared-file conflicts between parallel agents.

Tool extension test: a temporary packages/tools/extension-test was added with zero changes to shared code; it was auto-registered (registry size 1 -> 2) and rendered on the home page; then removed and all gates re-verified.
Retry/escalation rates are not applicable at Stage 0 (single task).
